title: How Sound Travels
summary: Sound needs a medium. It travels fastest through solids, slower through liquids and slowest through gases, and not at all through a vacuum. Echoes are reflected sound.
objectives: I can explain that sound needs a medium and cannot travel through a vacuum.
I can compare the speed of sound in solids, liquids and gases.
I can use echo times to calculate distances.
misconceptions: The air itself moves from the source to your ear.
